name: dev.ucp.shopping.purchase_options
title: Purchase Options Extension
description: Extends Catalog, Cart, Checkout, and Order so a Business can advertise the ways a variant can be bought, a Platform can select one by opaque identifier, and the resulting Order preserves the selected option. Where a variant carries `purchase_options`, exactly one is selected, the way exactly one payment term or fulfillment option is. An option that results in recurring orders states them as `schedules`. Also defines the `dev.ucp.shopping.policy.subscription` policy type, which governs every line whose selected option carries `schedules` and carries its disclosure.

variant_purchase_options.title: Variant Purchase Options
variant_purchase_options.description: The purchase option fields added to a catalog variant.

purchase_options.description: The ways this variant can be bought, in the Business's order of preference. The first entry is the default: the option the Business selects when a Platform adds the variant without choosing one, and whose `price` the variant's own `price` states. Where a variant can also be bought once, the one-time purchase is listed as an option; a list with no one-time option means the variant is sold only through the options listed. Absent when the variant is bought the ordinary way at its `price`.

purchase_options_variant.description: A catalog variant carrying purchase options.

purchase_options_lookup_variant.description: A lookup variant (carrying input correlation) carrying purchase options.

purchase_options_product.description: A catalog product whose variants carry purchase options. Used by search.

purchase_options_lookup_product.description: A lookup product whose variants carry purchase options, preserving input correlation. Used by lookup.

purchase_options_detail_product.description: A get_product detail product whose variants carry purchase options. Used by get_product.

line_item.title: Line Item with Purchase Options
line_item.description: Line item extended with the options its variant can be bought through and the one selected. `purchase_options` and `selected_purchase_option_id` are present together: a list of options without a selection would price the line under no stated option.

purchase_options.description: The ways this line's variant can be bought, priced for this cart or checkout, in the Business's order of preference. Unselected options are indicative; the selected option's price is the line's `item.price`. Absent when the variant is bought the ordinary way.

selected_purchase_option_id.description: ID of the selected purchase option. MUST match one `purchase_options[].id` from the catalog or the latest cart or checkout response. Present in a response whenever `purchase_options` is, and absent when it is not. Where the Platform has made no choice, the Business selects the default. A selection that no longer resolves is replaced by the default and reported with a `purchase_option_changed` warning; the Business never substitutes silently. Omitted on complete because the option is already agreed by then.

order_purchase_option.title: Order Purchase Option
order_purchase_option.description: Frozen record of the purchase option a line was bought through, including the recurring orders agreed to. Historical Order state, not a live catalog reference: the Business preserves it if the catalog option is later renamed, changed, or withdrawn, and a Platform MUST NOT assume `id` still resolves.

id.description: The option's identifier as accepted at checkout.

title.description: The option's title as presented at checkout.

schedules.description: The schedules of the selected option as agreed at checkout, unchanged afterwards: the agreement, not the subscription's live state. Present when the option resulted in recurring orders.

order_line_item.title: Order Line Item with Purchase Option
order_line_item.description: Order line extended with the purchase option it was bought through.

purchase_option.description: The purchase option selected for this line at checkout, including an explicitly listed one-time option, with the schedules agreed to where it resulted in recurring orders. Absent when the line's variant carried no purchase options.

subscription_policy.title: Subscription Policy
subscription_policy.description: A policy statement with type `dev.ucp.shopping.policy.subscription`, governing a line whose selected purchase option carries `schedules`. Its `description` states the terms of the subscription — that the line results in recurring orders and until when, how the buyer cancels, and where the buyer manages it; what each recurring order costs and when is stated by the option's `schedules`. One policy governs a line. Adds no fields to the base policy.

policies_item.description: A `policies[]` entry; validates against `subscription_policy` when `type` is `dev.ucp.shopping.policy.subscription`.

dev.ucp.shopping.catalog.search.description: Catalog search composition with purchase options (extends dev.ucp.shopping.catalog.search).

dev.ucp.shopping.catalog.lookup.description: Catalog lookup composition with purchase options (extends dev.ucp.shopping.catalog.lookup).

dev.ucp.shopping.cart.title: Cart with Purchase Options
dev.ucp.shopping.cart.description: Cart extended so each line can carry its variant's purchase options and the one selected, with subscription policies on `policies[]`.

dev.ucp.shopping.checkout.title: Checkout with Purchase Options
dev.ucp.shopping.checkout.description: Checkout extended so each line can carry its variant's purchase options and the one selected, with subscription policies on `policies[]`.

dev.ucp.shopping.order.title: Order with Purchase Options
dev.ucp.shopping.order.description: Order extended so each line preserves the purchase option it was bought through, with the subscription policies agreed to on `policies[]`.
